reason: Machine lens: CLC (1 byte, 2 cycles) dropped between ASL A and ADC b_ptr at &9B7F; all opcodes legal on the 65SC12 (DEC A/INC A are 65C02, no Rockwell ops), no decimal mode. Every path into .generic (BNE generic on ds_clip, BNE generic on dm_slot, compiled_part's compiled_none and unsafe exits, which restore ds_c from ds_n; kc_part, which never writes &CC) has ds_c = n = sprite_column_count[sprite], and every sprite with straight_sprite_hi <> 0 has n in 2..12 (&30,&31,&32 (&82),&36 (0) have no image and RTS earlier), so (n-1)<<3 <= 88 and the third ASL shifts out bit 5 of n-1 = 0: C = 0, ADC gives the same sum, carry and N/Z for the BCC after STA. No label on the CLC, nothing jumps to it, no self-modified operand in it; draw_column's mask/pix operands are written by label (resolve after the move). Moving everything after 1 byte down: branches near the &9C00 boundary (BPL raised &9BE9->&9C05, BCC up_cell &9C03->&9BEB) cross the page before and after; no other branch in ren_draw_sprite/draw_column changes crossing; no page-aligned label in bank 4 after &9B80 (none moves from &xx00 to &xxFF); ck_index,Y (&A3B2) moving to &A3B1 can only remove a crossing (Y=&4E). The straight sprite data's (d_ptr),Y crossings shift by one byte either way; the proposer's whole-pass bench measurement (-2 seed 1, -1 RIGHT) shows the net is still a saving, and the gate will remeasure. Branch ranges unchanged or shorter by 1 for the two forward BCC/BPL draw_column.each (still in range).
